discoveries.evidence: Complete retained source tables: 2,032 formulae / 11,138 component rows and 27,536 diet flags.
discoveries.decision: Register formula/process-factor types. Amounts and source diet flags do not become independently qualified ready-to-cook recipes or dietary certifications.
Preserve linear/damped/fixed scaling, optionality, bilingual names and aligned source-published steps. Do not silently replace scaling with linear arithmetic.
Preserve original document hash and paragraph locator. Partial ingredient extraction is explicit and excluded from stock sufficiency/planning.

discoveries.source: National composition tables / FoodFiles / Fineli / Sweden
discoveries.decision: Component vs whole-food denominators, qualifiers, analytical/source definitions and preparation states stay distinct.
Separate company/site roles and candidate identities from verified ownership, production origin and inventory availability.
Retain permission evidence and source locators. Noncommercial-only or unidentified content licences do not permit unrestricted corpus redistribution.

Keep fixed RDF identifiers, original attributes/lexical forms and formal RDF/XML expressions; localize display labels separately. Source language-tag irregularities remain visible; imported class URIs do not establish ingredient, nutrition or dietary equivalence.
Schema identifiers/links accept Unicode IRIs under RFC 3987; source identities are retained, never translated into replacement identifiers.
Four prose definitions declared as xsd:anyURI remain preserved in originalRdfNotation; their text interpretations are candidate assertions. Strict IRI validation remains enabled.

Register source-defined units as subtype of Unit. Preserve dimensional context, normative symbols/factors and conventions separately from ambiguous recipe notations; no mass-volume, density, yield or historical default inferred.

discoveries.source: Wellcome pinned cookbook work and IIIF manifest metadata
discoveries.status: local metadata acquisition only; no recipe text admitted

existingRepresentation.workAndCanvas: SourceDocument / SourceRecord with fixed IIIF IDs and cited typed canvas metadata
existingRepresentation.rightsScope: ReusePermission / SourceLicenceNotice plus cited provider statement; jurisdiction and conflicting edition notices retained
existingRepresentation.editionContext: SourceAssertion / CulturalRepresentation with source-declared edition context; translationOf requires separately verified text equivalence

discoveries.decision: Use existing registered source and rights types for the retained metadata. Keep proposed more specific types for review when page or text extraction introduces an actual additional semantic need. Provider PDM statements do not imply independently verified worldwide clearance.
